newsitem.title: USA: BOXING-LOPEZ STOPS PARK IN FIRST ROUND TO KEEP TITLE.
newsitem.headline: BOXING-LOPEZ STOPS PARK IN FIRST ROUND TO KEEP TITLE.

text.p: Mexico's Ricardo Lopez, the little guy with dynamite in his fists, overwhelmed South Korean challenger Myung-Sup Park, stopping him in the first round to easily hold onto his World Boxing Council strawweight title on Saturday.
Lopez went right after Park from the opening bell and just 2:22 into the fight he had completed his 18th consecutive title defence, raising his record to 44-0.

Park managed to duck a wild right by Lopez, but the champion followed with a devastating roundhouse left hook to the face that put Park on his back with blood from his nose splattered all over his body.
The dazed Korean got to his feet before being counted out, but Lopez landed a couple more uncontested blows to the challenger's head and the referee quickly stepped in and stopped the fight.
"I wasn't looking for knockout," Lopez said through an interpreter. "I just take advantage of what comes.
"I missed and then I hit him very well."
